description: This Java class 'FtlWriter' processes FreeMarker Template Language (FTL) templates, rendering them to Appendable outputs. It manages template environments, processes template strings, and handles rendering of various RenderableFtl objects via a visitor pattern.

classes.name: FtlWriter
classes.description: A class that processes FTL templates, rendering them to Appendable outputs, managing environments, and utilizing a visitor pattern for RenderableFtl objects.

classes.name: RenderableFtlFtlWriterVisitor
classes.description: Inner class implementing RenderableFtlVisitor to process RenderableFtl objects by rendering their contents as FTL templates.

methods.name: FtlWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the FtlWriter with a macro library path and a visual theme.

methods.name: processFtl
methods.description: Processes a RenderableFtl object and writes the result to the provided Appendable.

methods.name: processFtlString
methods.description: Processes an FTL string as a template and writes the output to the Appendable.

methods.name: getEnvironment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a FreeMarker Environment for rendering templates, setting locale as needed.
